digest.component_or_area: ticket close STATUS event and reduced state
propositions: A reader cannot distinguish a close with signature-append failure from a close with the gate off, because both collapse to the same state on read.

The gate state at close time is read from config and discarded, so 'closed without attestation' conflates gate-off, --force, config-unreadable, local unattested, and signature-append failure into one state.

The completion_expectation enum must be persisted as a present-only field on the *->closed STATUS event in the same locked write as the close, with eight distinct values (required, disposition, gate_off, gate_unreadable, force_bypassed, local_source, not_certifiable, not_applicable) to enable later readers to distinguish close provenance.

A reader combining the durable completion_expectation with the durable attestation must separate closed-and-signed (required + attestation), signature-lost (required with no attestation), gate-off, and disposition closes.

The expectation must be computed by _completion_precheck as the second half of a returned pair, consuming the tri-state GateState to distinguish gate-off from gate_unreadable, with gate state resolving first.

The idea->closed transition must record not_applicable explicitly in close_ticket without invoking _completion_precheck, and the field must fold into reduced state alongside close_class and force_close_reason.
